classes.EXPLICIT_IN_WINDOW: Direct meaning support in actually exposed frozen evidence.
classes.INFERABLE_IN_WINDOW: Conclusion from cited exposed premises; record steps/assumptions, not related words.
classes.ONLY_OUTSIDE_WINDOW: Support in declared eligible bytes but not exposed window; pin outside span.
classes.ABSENT_OR_UNKNOWN: Support unlocated/unavailable or exposure incomplete; no invented absence.

controls: Each missing conjunct separately, no averaging. Sound support versus irrelevant citation; remove/move support outside window; truncate exposure; invalid narrow-to-broad inference; equivalent wording preserves class. Root checks controls.
attribution: Complete exposure+explicit support+omitted response meaning indicates actor omission. Outside-only indicates selection gap; absent support is input gap. Inferable/unknown yields qualified mixed attribution, not proven model cause. Prepared packet is not observed loading.
preserve: Original PARTIAL/freeze/clauses unchanged. No regrade, new thresholds, actor answers, retries or calls. Evidence sufficiency remains separate from semantic verdict.
